proposal.reason: Primary change is removing CollNet functionality from network transport/plugin and proxy paths (including CollNet plugin loading and backend removal). Additional substantive changes require transport review for connection/resource path deletion, kernels for removing executable CollNet device kernels while keeping reserved slot IDs, graph-search for deleting CollNet graph construction/connection and related topology graph handling, tuning for disabling CollNet in cost models/algorithm enablement, enqueue for runtime planning/chunking/pattern and tuner-fallback execution guards, and tuner-plugin for preserved v1 callback ABI semantics with unsupported CollNet selection fallback behavior.
